name: Vector Index Benchmark
description: Benchmark v26.2 CREATE VECTOR INDEX features: indexed vs non-indexed, prefix column filtering, beam size tuning

setup_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bench_documents (id INT8 PRIMARY KEY, title STRING NOT NULL, content STRING NOT NULL, category STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general', embedding FLOAT8[] NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())
CREATE VECTOR INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_bench_docs_embedding ON bench_documents (embedding vector_cosine_ops)
CREATE VECTOR INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_bench_docs_category_embedding ON bench_documents (category, embedding vector_cosine_ops)

operations.name: insert_vectors
sql: INSERT INTO bench_documents (id, title, content, category, embedding) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::FLOAT8[])

operations.name: search_indexed
sql: SET vector_search_beam_size = 32; SELECT id, title, embedding <=> $1::FLOAT8[] AS distance FROM bench_documents ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::FLOAT8[] LIMIT 10

operations.name: search_filtered
sql: SET vector_search_beam_size = 32; SELECT id, title, embedding <=> $1::FLOAT8[] AS distance FROM bench_documents WHERE category = $2 ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::FLOAT8[] LIMIT 10

operations.name: search_no_index
sql: SELECT id, title, (SELECT sum(a.v * b.v) FROM unnest(embedding) WITH ORDINALITY AS a(v, i), unnest($1::FLOAT8[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS b(v, i) WHERE a.i = b.i) AS similarity FROM bench_documents ORDER BY similarity DESC LIMIT 10

operations.name: beam_size_tuning
sql: SET vector_search_beam_size = 8; SELECT id, title, embedding <=> $1::FLOAT8[] AS distance FROM bench_documents ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::FLOAT8[] LIMIT 10
SET vector_search_beam_size = 64; SELECT id, title, embedding <=> $1::FLOAT8[] AS distance FROM bench_documents ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::FLOAT8[] LIMIT 10
